## Research Track Explorer

This demo lets the learner click a research track and see:

- a small question;
- the unit of observation;
- a possible paper output;
- a beginner Python task.

The rendered HTML version is `interactive_demo.html`. It is designed for static deployment on GitHub Pages.

Source note: Quarto is not installed in the current authoring environment, so `interactive_demo.html` is currently a hand-authored static fallback that mirrors this design. When Quarto is available, move the same HTML/JavaScript block into this QMD and render it with:

```bash
quarto render interactive_demo.qmd
```

```{=html}
<div id="track-demo"></div>
```

In the rendered fallback HTML, this area is replaced by a Plotly-backed interactive chart and track selector.
